title: State-Dependent Metric Projection Neural Network for Variational Inequalities
summary: Projection-based dynamical systems and projection neural networks offer a continuous-time approach to solving variational inequalities by driving the state toward its projection onto the feasible set. However, most existing models are built on a fixed Euclidean or constant metric, which can lead to poor conditioning and slow convergence when the operator or feasible set geometry is highly anisotropic.
